limitations: WEB-03 owns selected-agent metadata, bounded recent runs, and deployment-only configuration. Dry runs remain WEB-04, approvals WEB-05, full run timelines and artifacts WEB-06, narrow/mobile tree behavior WEB-07, and exhaustive accessibility acceptance WEB-08.
A static detail response explicitly reports recent-run data as unavailable. The interface never converts runtime absence into a confirmed never_run state and never invents history.

The browser gate uses the real production Vite build and real hierarchy, detail, and session APIs. It overlays deterministic same-origin runtime, configuration-schema, success, conflict, and 304 boundaries because a fresh local runtime store is intentionally optional.

The accepted concept contains illustrative vendor branding, approval counts, historical dates, View all, and Run with mocks controls. WEB-03 uses source-authoritative vendor-neutral data and omits future-scope or inert actions.
DEL-07 still owns a generated TypeScript API client and drift gate. WEB-03 validates unknown responses through endpoint-specific strict normalizers without claiming generated-client parity.
